title: The drink-can metal on top of the Washington Monument

scenes.say: This tower's tip is made of your drink can metal. And in eighteen eighty four, that was a HUGE flex. Guess why!
This is it. A small pyramid of aluminium, about a hundred ounces. So quick, what cost more back then? Aluminium, or silver?
Aluminium! TWICE the price of silver. So before it went up, it sat in a posh New York jewellery shop, like a diamond.
But the French were even crazier. At the huge Paris fair in eighteen fifty five, bars of aluminium were shown off like treasure!
Then Emperor Napoleon the Third got aluminium forks, only for his MOST important guests. Everyone else? Stuck with boring old gold, or so the story goes!
So what went wrong? In eighteen eighty six, a twenty two year old from this college in Ohio found a cheap way to make it, with electricity! And a Frenchman found the same trick that very same year!
You see, there's loads of aluminium in rocks like these. It was just super hard to get out. So the price crashed. Now it's one of the cheapest metals around.
